content.rendered:
Can anything scream “summer at the Jersey shore” more than Bruce Springsteen singing “Under the Boardwalk?” I don’t think so.

Here’s the first time Bruce played the The Drifters’ 1964 classic, with Bobby Bandiera at The Stone Pony on June 24, 1989.

“Under the Boardwalk” is a sequel of sorts to “Up on the Roof,” another gorgeous Drifters song that Bruce has covered a few times (but we’ll cover that another day). Here’s the original, but you almost certainly know it–the opening notes played on bass, gourd, and triangle are instantly recognizable.

Bruce covered “Under the Boardwalk” a few more times over the years. The last time was at a telethon for Hurricane Sandy relief–and it was a team-up as well, this time a bit more star-studded:

Under the Boardwalk
First performed: June 24, 1989 (Asbury Park, NJ)
Last performed: November 2, 2012 (New York City, NY)

© May 4, 2018

excerpt.rendered: Bruce and Bobby cover “Under the Boardwalk” on the Jersey Shore on the third day of summer. There’s no setting more perfect for that song.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Come on Over to My Place
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Drifters' classic makes frequent appearances at the Stone Pony in 1982.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Ruby Baby
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Twice only: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band turn in steamy performances of "Ruby Baby" at The Stone Pony in the summer of 1987.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Hound Dog
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Twice only: Bruce plays one of the all-time great rock and roll songs during surprise appearances at The Stone Pony in the summer of '89.

jetpack-related-posts.title: December 22
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Watch Bruce's surprise appearance at a 2008 holiday show. Plus: Bruce heads west and gets his California driver's license. These and more highlights inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: December 18
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce plays "Who'll Stop the Rain" for the first time. Plus: Listen to Bruce's Asbury Park holiday show from 2000.

jetpack-related-posts.title: December 5
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: President Obama and an all-star line-up of musicians pay tribute to Bruce at the Kennedy Center Honors. Video and more highlights from this date in Springsteen history inside.
